verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. A product of this kind could plausibly offer natural-language control, so the axis applies. Its documented inputs are all direct manipulation: touch, trackpad, keyboard, Apple Pencil, menus and an apps list. The candidate-composition feature (sill-docs-25) is text input, not natural-language commanding, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes found nothing, so nothing shows the product interpreting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
